Info

Concrete implementation of binary wire frame assembler.

class scarajectory.infrastructure.communication.protocol.binary.binary_frame_builder.BinaryFrameBuilder[source]¶

Bases: object

Assembles and checksums wire protocol binary frames for transmission.

It defines:

attributes:
SOF1 - First start of frame byte delimiter (0xAA).
SOF2 - Second start of frame byte delimiter (0x55).
EOF - End of frame byte delimiter (0x0D).
JOINT_STEPS_FORMAT - Struct format for 22-byte joint step payload.
methods:
build_frame - Encodes generic binary command frame with CRC16.
build_joint_move - Builds joint step movement frame.
build_system_cmd - Builds parameterless system command.
build_tool_cmd - Builds tool state actuation frame.
pack_frame - Serializes complete frame with delimiters and CRC.
EOF: ClassVar[int] = 13¶
JOINT_STEPS_FORMAT: ClassVar[str] = '<iiiIIH'¶
SOF1: ClassVar[int] = 170¶
SOF2: ClassVar[int] = 85¶
build_frame(*, msg_id: MessageId, seq_num: int, payload: bytes = b'') → BinaryFrame[source]¶

Constructs and checksums a complete wire protocol BinaryFrame.

Parameters:

  • msg_id – Command message identifier.

  • seq_num – Cyclic sequence index (0 - 255).

  • payload – Raw body bytes (0 to 64 bytes).

Returns:

Fully assembled BinaryFrame with valid CRC16.

build_joint_move(*, seq_num: int, steps: JointSteps) → BinaryFrame[source]¶

Builds a joint step motion frame from JointSteps model.

Parameters:

  • seq_num – Cyclic sequence index.

  • steps – JointSteps target instance.

Returns:

Assembled BinaryFrame with joint move payload.

build_system_cmd(*, msg_id: MessageId, seq_num: int) → BinaryFrame[source]¶

Builds a parameterless system command frame (ENABLE, ESTOP, PING, etc.).

Parameters:

  • msg_id – Target command message identifier.

  • seq_num – Cyclic sequence index.

Returns:

Assembled parameterless BinaryFrame.

build_tool_cmd(*, seq_num: int, tool_id: int, state: bool) → BinaryFrame[source]¶

Builds a tool actuation command frame (PUMP, VALVE).

Parameters:

  • seq_num – Cyclic sequence index.

  • tool_id – Tool identifier (0=PUMP, 1=VALVE).

  • state – True to activate, False to deactivate.

Returns:

Assembled tool command BinaryFrame.

pack_frame(*, frame: BinaryFrame) → bytes[source]¶

Encodes the frame into a byte string according to wire format.

Parameters:

frame – BinaryFrame instance to serialize.

Returns:

Formatted bytes: SOF1 + SOF2 + MSG + SEQ + LEN + DATA + CRC + EOF.
